basic_details.job_title: NSUT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Campus Director, Assistant Registrar Posts
basic_details.short_information: Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), a state university under Act 06 of 2018, Govt. of NCT of Delhi (formerly Netaji Subhas Institute of Technology), has invited online applications for two Group A posts under Recruitment Notice No. NSUT/ GROUP A POSTS/2026/04: Campus Director (tenure post for 03 years, Level 14, rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/-, one post for OBC) and Assistant Registrar (regular post, Level 10, Rs. 56,100-1,77,500/-, one post for UR). how_to_apply: Find the online application form in the prescribed format on the university website, nsut.ac.in, where it is available from 10 November 2026.
Submit the online application latest by 15 December 2026 (Tuesday).
Submit the hard copy of the filled application form along with the relevant enclosures up to 30 December 2026 (Wednesday), by 1700 hrs.
The notice does not say where or how the hard copy is to be sent, or which enclosures are needed; these are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: About NSUT
content_sections.text: Netaji Subhas University of Technology is a state university under Act 06 of 2018, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, formerly Netaji Subhas Institute of Technology. Its address is Azad Hind Fauj Marg, Sector – 3, Dwarka, New Delhi – 110078. The notice is issued by the Registrar, NSUT.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NSUT has announced 2 Group A posts in total.

Level – 10 (Rs. 56,100 -1,77,500/-) as per 7th CPC and as revised from time to time

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, experience or age limit for either post. It states that the number of posts, educational qualifications, experience, short-listing criteria and terms and conditions of appointment will be available on the university website nsut.ac.in from 10 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification and that website for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: This is a tenure post for 03 years. Pay is Level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- as per 7th CPC and as revised from time to time. This is a regular post. Pay is Level 10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500/-) as per 7th CPC and as revised from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NSUT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Find the online application form in the prescribed format on the university website, nsut.ac.in, where it is available from 10 November 2026. Submit the online application latest by 15 December 2026 (Tuesday). Submit the hard copy of the filled application form along with the relevant enclosures up to 30 December 2026 (Wednesday), by 1700 hrs. The notice does not say where or how the hard copy is to be sent, or which enclosures are needed; these are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has NSUT announced in this recruitment?
faq.answer: NSUT has announced 2 Group A posts: 01 Campus Director (OBC) and 01 Assistant Registrar (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for NSUT Group A posts?
faq.answer: The online application is due latest by 15 December 2026 (Tuesday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the filled application form with relevant enclosures is due up to 30 December 2026 (Wednesday), by 1700 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. When will the NSUT application form be available?
faq.answer: The online application form and other details will be available on the university website nsut.ac.in from 10 November 2026 (Tuesday).

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the NSUT Campus Director post?
faq.answer: The Campus Director post carries Level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- as per 7th CPC and as revised from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for the NSUT Assistant Registrar post?
faq.answer: The Assistant Registrar post carries Level 10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500/-) as per 7th CPC and as revised from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. Is the NSUT Campus Director post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes the Campus Director as a tenure post for 03 years, while the Assistant Registrar is described as a regular post.

faq.question: Q8. Which category is each NSUT post reserved for?
faq.answer: The Campus Director post is marked 01 (OBC) and the Assistant Registrar post is marked 01 (UR).

faq.question: Q9. How do I apply for NSUT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed format by 15 December 2026, then submit the hard copy of the filled form with relevant enclosures by 30 December 2026, 1700 hrs.
